title: Promotion Exam: Scoring Pinfu
description: A promotion exam with no yaku shown: count the han of a riichi mahjong pinfu hand and answer the score at 20 fu for tsumo or 30 fu for ron. You can make at most one mistake
questionPrompt: Answer the score for this win
koTsumoScore: Score (from each non-dealer / from the dealer)

howToPlay.title: Question format
howToPlay.lead: You will get hands won with pinfu. The yaku are not shown, so count the han yourself and answer the score from the scoring table: 20 fu for tsumo, 30 fu for ron.
